title: Homes (Neoforge)
description: Adds new commands for setting homes and teleporting to your homes easily!
body:
Homes - 1.1



This is a server-side mod for NeoForge 1.21.8.



Commands:

/home {set, delete, replace, tp} {home number 1-5}
/homes (operator command. this allows you to see other people's set homes) {tp} {username} {home number 1-5}
/homesinfo (displays whats new and tells what version the mod is currently in)

If you find any bugs please report it in our [Github](https://github.com/Destroyer9493/homes-minecraft-mod/issues) page!
